page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on KVM hypervisor architecture. Powered by 48 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs across 24 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, the instance features AVX-512 vector instructions and a 33 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 368 GB of RAM and is equipped with four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs providing a combined 128 GB of VRAM. Dedicated network baseline throughput reaches 16 Gbps, while local instance storage is absent, requiring external block storage for persistent data.

Benchmark metrics reflect moderate CPU compute relative to parallel GPU capacity. Single-core performance tests such as stress-ng and single-threaded compression show lower per-core efficiency, whereas multi-core execution scales across all 48 vCPUs to achieve average performance levels in multi-threaded decompression and Redis operations at 33.18 million operations per second. Memory read and write bandwidth tests maintain expected throughput for large cache footprints.

The architecture prioritizes GPU acceleration over raw per-core CPU speeds. The lack of integrated local storage creates dependency on attached network block volumes, which can impact storage-heavy pipelines. From a cost-efficiency perspective, allocating four V100 GPUs alongside 368 GB memory suits workloads that maximize parallel processing capability without over-allocating storage resources. Primary workload fits include deep learning model training, AI inference, large-scale scientific simulations, rendering, and parallel data analysis tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores at 2.5 GHz, it integrates 368 GB of system memory and four NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs offering 128 GB of aggregate VRAM. Networking features a 16 Gbps baseline, with zero local disk storage provided natively. Benchmarks demonstrate solid multi-threaded performance, yielding average scores in multi-core stress testing, Redis operations, and memory bandwidth, despite weaker single-threaded CPU metrics. The setup presents a specialized hardware profile balancing dense VRAM capacity against centralized CPU performance. Ideal applications encompass deep learning, neural network inference, matrix computations, computer vision, and scientific data simulations requiring high parallel throughput.
